scope: deterministic public multi-device PortMaster ZIPs built from explicit redistributable inputs, including independently audited execution-role ABIs for NXExtract UI, splash, game and helpers
method: Every M18 item is tied to implementation and an offline adversarial gate. The launcher, NXExtract UI, nxsplash helper, public payload and all Linux ELFs are pinned and independently reaudited. Passing M18 proves package integrity and policy compliance; it does not replace virgin installation and gameplay acceptance of the exact ZIP on target devices.

guarantees: stage copies only manifest-declared kinds and paths
implicit globs and unclassified ELFs fail
residual_scope: the manifest author remains responsible for selecting only files intended for public redistribution
tests: add an unknown kind and an ELF hidden below payload

guarantees: absolute, parent-traversal and noncanonical paths are rejected
source, stage and ZIP symlinks are rejected before trust or extraction
residual_scope: publication paths still require a POSIX filesystem that supports the fail-closed atomic primitives
tests: exercise manifest traversal, source symlink, ZIP traversal and ZIP symlink entries

guarantees: NFC plus case-fold keys reject portable-media collisions in stage, inventory and final ZIP
file-versus-directory collisions are rejected independently
residual_scope: the policy deliberately chooses a conservative portable-name subset rather than filesystem-specific behavior
tests: append composed and decomposed Unicode names to an otherwise valid ZIP

guarantees: the single-launcher to version-qualified nxbootstrap chain is exact, pinned and structurally parsed; its canonical compatibility copy is byte-identical and nxdeployment.json binds launcher, bootstrap and config
a secondary run.sh layer, a second top-level launcher, dead PortMaster tokens, backgrounding and unapproved exec targets fail
residual_scope: game-specific executable choice remains in the versioned nxbootstrap manifest, not in nxrelease defaults
tests: mutate deployment bytes and every launcher hop, inject run.sh and a second top-level launcher, and make a required PortMaster call unreachable

guarantees: schema v2 and the stricter runtime validator reject unknown or missing fields
legacy v1 is rejected instead of receiving unsafe defaults
residual_scope: schema evolution requires a new explicit version and migration, never silent reinterpretation
tests: feed legacy, unknown-field and capability-order manifests

guarantees: NXExtract 1.2.10 code, runner, runtime helper, separately versioned 1.2.9 architecture-selected low-GLIBC UI and recipe are all content-pinned

the canonical UI manifest, source hash, architecture row, ELF class and machine are revalidated together with the engine/UI version split, version floor, recipe schema, package-required flexible APK-container identity and active runner references
residual_scope: user-owned game data is extracted at runtime and never staged into the public ZIP
tests: mutate each NXExtract pin, remove/relabel the UI, cross-pin the ARMv7 UI into AArch64, remove the runtime helper, reject exact size or one APK identity, and preserve the real Angry Birds, Retro Highway and transformed ScourgeBringer recipe shapes

guarantees: public packages require a hash-pinned schema-v4 port.json and bilingual INSTALLATION.md at the canonical path
items, items_opt, runtime, title, architecture, glibc and image references must agree with the exact package bytes
residual_scope: gameinfo.xml and images remain optional; when declared, their bytes and references are strict
tests: remove portmaster metadata, port.json or INSTALLATION.md; mutate runtime/types/items/title/arch/glibc and either language section

guarantees: every packaged ELF is classified, loadable and audited for ABI, segments, dynamic tags and symbol-version ceilings

generation-v2 store ELF mirrors use nxruntime-generation-linux, inherit the complete live Linux metadata, preserve authenticated private-library mode 0644 including a helper-only DSO under the active NXExtract tree, match the logical path, mode and SHA-256, and are audited without becoming duplicate dependency providers
DT_NEEDED closure requires one explicit provider per namespace and architecture
residual_scope: historical reference ELFs that fail M17 remain ineligible for M18 packaging
tests: exercise class, float ABI, interpreter, RPATH, GLIBC and dependency-provider failures

render project, ordinary and NXExtract-private libraries 0644, NXSplash and NXExtract UI live/store ELF pairs plus non-ELF controls, then reject wrong class and live/store path, both directions of mode drift, SHA-256 or metadata drift

guarantees: public packages require SPDX/source metadata tied to a pinned LICENSE, NOTICE or COPYING member
the final metadata revalidates the same license map
residual_scope: the gate validates the declared redistribution map; legal interpretation of third-party terms remains a release-owner responsibility
tests: remove package.license and point its file at a non-license payload

guarantees: APK, APKS, XAPK, OBB, JAR and dex suffixes are forbidden
Android/BYO ELF is not an allowed release kind, cannot hide as payload and cannot be relabelled Linux while importing Bionic SONAMEs
residual_scope: M17 may inspect owner-provided Android ELFs outside the release; M18 never redistributes them
tests: attempt APK, OBB and dex payloads plus an android-upstream ELF

guarantees: saves, temp, cache, logs, core dumps, bytecode and private config paths are excluded
the scan runs again on staged and archived bytes
residual_scope: runtime-created writable data belongs outside the immutable release inventory
tests: stage save, cache, log, core and temporary suffix/path fixtures

guarantees: personal home paths, IPv4 literals, hostname assignments and credential literals are scanned from text and metadata
raw host data causes a hard failure
residual_scope: binary blobs with no text signature still depend on the strict allowlist, hashes and provenance
tests: inject a private path, address, hostname assignment and password literal

guarantees: funding filenames and donation/sponsorship advocacy are rejected from public package bytes
residual_scope: license attribution remains allowed and is distinct from funding advocacy
tests: inject FUNDING.yml and donation text independently

guarantees: ZIP timestamp, member order, compression, regular-file type and 0644 or 0755 modes are canonical
ZIP stores no variable owner identity
residual_scope: source filesystem ownership is intentionally discarded rather than reproduced
tests: inspect every ZipInfo timestamp, external mode and sorted member order

guarantees: two builds from identical inputs produce byte-identical ZIPs and external checksums
residual_scope: changing any source, manifest pin or tool version intentionally produces new bytes
tests: compare two clean builds and an atomic bundle byte for byte

guarantees: the produced ZIP is reopened and independently checks CRC, members, modes, strict metadata, manifest, SBOM, NXExtract and ELFs
build and verify invoke audit-portmaster-zip.py on the actual ZIP path, reject retired nxbootstrap.sh and audit every shell/shebang for external stat
verify with a previous archive additionally executes the real offline install, discovery, restart, update, uninstall and reinstall lifecycle
external SHA-256 is verified against final bytes
residual_scope: device installation is intentionally M22 acceptance, after final-byte verification
tests: tamper one payload byte without updating MANIFEST.sha256
repack metadata with BOM, duplicate key or NaN
capture the exact ZIP path handed to the independent auditor and exercise update over the previous ZIP, legacy bootstrap plus direct/indirect stat fixtures

guarantees: ELF audit is based on headers, program headers, dynamic data and version info rather than requiring section headers
a loadable sectionless ELF passes and is reaudited from final ZIP bytes
residual_scope: a malformed ELF still fails whenever GNU readelf cannot provide a required phase
tests: strip the section-header table from a real AArch64 fixture

guarantees: adversarial ZIP traversal, symlink, duplicate/collision, tamper and malformed metadata paths fail before publication
residual_scope: the test corpus is extensible; a newly discovered ZIP attack becomes a new permanent fixture
tests: run the offline hostile ZIP corpus on every nxrelease change

guarantees: release emits external SHA-256, internal MANIFEST.sha256, full inventory, deterministic CycloneDX SBOM and input-manifest provenance
ELF records include hash, ABI, dependencies, ceiling and provenance
residual_scope: SBOM describes shipped bytes; owner-supplied runtime game data is deliberately absent
tests: cross-check SBOM coverage and hashes against the inventory and final ZIP

guarantees: exclusive per-destination locks, no-replace publication and inode-aware rollback prevent overwrite under races
bundle publishes ZIP and checksum through one directory rename
residual_scope: non-POSIX filesystems fail closed and must not be used as the build/publication destination
tests: race archive, checksum and bundle destinations with a competing owner

guarantees: existing ZIP, checksum, stage or bundle paths are never overwritten
source and input-manifest hashes force new bytes after changes
residual_scope: release naming/versioning remains a publisher decision, but every attempt must use a new destination
tests: attempt to rebuild over an existing ZIP and verify its hash remains unchanged

guarantees: one offline suite covers positive build, deterministic rebuild, strict JSON, mandatory installation/metadata and all recorded adversarial classes
the full chain runs with stat absent from PATH and role-specific prepare, runner, runtime and extensionless helper gates reject external stat
every negative case must fail with the expected boundary
residual_scope: hardware behavior is not part of a host-side adversarial package audit
tests: run test_nxrelease.sh with all required local compilers and tools through its private PATH without stat

guarantees: recovery documents atomic stage, pair publication, bundle, independent re-audit and rollback by prior path/SHA
cleanup instructions identify only owned hidden temporary directories
residual_scope: operators must list and verify an orphan temporary directory before manual removal
tests: simulate interrupted stage, pair race and bundle race without deleting a competitor inode

guarantees: the machine closure receipt covers all 25 plan items and the full offline release suite passes
M18 closure remains separate from exact-ZIP physical acceptance
residual_scope: publishing is authorized only after later milestones validate the exact new ZIP on declared devices
tests: run the M18 closure validator and nxrelease adversarial suite in the safe-gate matrix

guarantees: nxbootstrap 0.6.15 releases contain exactly one NXExtract 1.2.10 engine with the 1.2.9 UI selected from its canonical multiarch manifest plus exactly one architecture-matched nxsplash 0.1.2 classified as nxsplash-linux, both UI helpers mode 0755 and SHA-pinned
both helpers are audited as Linux ELFs under the same low-GLIBC, dependency, inventory, SBOM and final-archive gates as the game executable

launcher order is NXExtract/UI when needed, validated terminal result, payload validation, mandatory five-second splash on every launch, adapter/private libraries and only then native game lifecycle, with no removal switch
residual_scope: ports adopt the component explicitly and historical packages remain pinned to their prior nxrelease
physical visibility and handoff still require acceptance of the exact final ZIP on every declared family
tests: omit, relabel and alter the helper, mutate or reorder its launcher block, inspect its final ZIP mode, metadata and complete ELF audit
